title: Correct the FTS refresh cost wording for trigram posting-list work
outcome: Make the FTS refresh documentation and code comment accurately describe index-assisted trigram lookup costs.
acceptance: The cost explanation in docs/features/sqlite-store.md and src/storage/work/planning/catalog_fts.rs states that lookup depends on trigram posting lists and mentioning candidates, with worst-case O(N), and does not promise O(H) in complete-ref matches alone or claim an unmeasured universal speed factor.

completion.summary: The FTS refresh cost wording for trigram posting-list work is corrected and landed (in the ancestry of e7426a6); verified on the Windows B gate bundle test-fdd408e3. An independent acceptance evaluation passed criterion 1 (record 0dc7a635a17f46cd90695aff2f31e94e).
